**Finding: Compliant** (no redline)

The only MFN mechanic in the Agreement is § 6 (p0047), which runs **in our favour**: TrueLink agrees that Hosting Services rates "will not exceed that charged by TrueLink to any other party," plus a one-year cost freeze. Nothing obliges Mortgage Logic.com to extend TrueLink terms given to third parties or to match third-party offers — the COMPENSATION section imposes only ordinary payment obligations on Client.

This sits at the playbook's **preferred** position (no MFN burdening the Customer, Vendor-granted best pricing preserved), so per the direction-rule guidance I have not flagged or redlined a provision that benefits us.
